breakdown.description: The prompt makes the torsional shear vanish at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is also maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the incorrect statement: 'Assume the torsional shear stress vanishes at the outer surface for principal stress calculation.' The ground truth resolves this by removing the erroneous claim entirely, since torsional shear stress is actually maximum at the outer surface of a solid circular shaft. The agent failed to fix this inconsistency and instead preserved the physically incorrect assumption from the incomplete prompt.
